## Objective
- Upgrade the empty project into a premium cinematic 3D portfolio website for Marvelous Mark Santos, using the supplied portrait and building and testing the implementation.

## Requirements
- Use real interactive 3D geometry, cinematic lighting, particles, camera movement, scroll transitions, and interactive project cards; do not substitute static images for 3D objects.
- Use the supplied photo without regenerating or reshaping the face; optimize for Android, reduced motion, and WebGL fallback.
- The user requested no clarification questions and asked for brief assumptions at completion.

## Decisions
- Built a static HTML/CSS/JavaScript site with Three.js from a CDN, matching the empty repository scaffold; used custom scroll, reveal, and card animations rather than adding React, Drei, GSAP, or Framer Motion.
- Used the provided portrait exactly as uploaded, displayed contained within a framed profile presentation.

## Work State
### Completed
- Created `index.html`, `styles.css`, and `app.js` for a responsive portfolio with hero, about, project gallery, approach, and contact sections.
- Added real Three.js scene elements: metallic nameplate and emblem, orbital rings, geometric objects, energy sphere, holographic panel, particle field, scene lighting, and scroll-linked camera movement.
- Added mobile navigation, keyboard-operable project cards and detail modal, pointer parallax, reduced-motion handling, and a CSS fallback background.
- Downloaded the supplied portrait to `assets/marvelous-mark-santos.png`.
- Started a local Python server on port 3002 and installed Playwright Chromium after the initial browser launch failed because it was missing.

### Active
- Validate the running site in Playwright, check console/runtime issues and responsive appearance, then fix any issues found.

### Blocked
- Browser validation has not yet been rerun after installing Chromium.

## Next Move
1. Run `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` and inspect page rendering, console/runtime errors, and screenshots.
2. Test mobile layout, navigation, project modal, and reduced-motion behavior; fix any issues.
3. Report completed work and testing results, noting the assumption that this is a portfolio site and that the scaffold uses plain HTML/Three.js.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: portfolio structure and project/modal content.
- `styles.css`: visual design, responsive layout, interactions, and fallback styling.
- `app.js`: Three.js scene, camera/scroll motion, parallax, navigation, and project modal.
- `assets/marvelous-mark-santos.png`: exact supplied portrait.

## Important Context
- Local server command is `python3 -m http.server 3002`; it was launched in the background and should still be serving.
- First `playwright-cli open http://localhost:3002` failed with `Browser "chromium" is not installed`; `playwright-cli install-browser chromium` then completed successfully.
